Behind the image
07 / Ivory Knit
REFERENCE 4991.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 010
Art direction: Seamless white studio, full-length pose, ample space around the outfit, fabric detail
preserved.
Full-length fashion lookbook photograph of an original adult woman with long copper red waves,
cream cropped tweed-knit cardigan, coordinating fitted knit mini skirt and camisole, delicate metal
necklace, tall cream boots and small black handbag, white seamless studio, direct neutral gaze,
even diffused lighting, tactile high resolution fabric detail, contemporary romantic fashion
campaign, no logos or text.
08 / Powder Blue
REFERENCE 4992.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 011
Art direction: Full-body framing, pale blue and white, dark accessory accents, clear textures.
Full body vertical fashion lookbook of an original adult woman wearing a powder blue rib knit
buttoned cardigan with gently flared sleeves and a matching pleated mini skirt, white faux fur leg
warmers, black chunky loafers, large silver hoop earrings and a small beaded handbag. Loose
updo, white seamless backdrop, diffused even studio light, Y2K styling, crisp fabric detail, no text
or logos.
